metadata.description: Median household income for Black or African American householders (ACS table B19013B), cividis navy (low) to gold (high). Measured over all 437 districts with a published value: 6 classes with breaks at $55k/$70k/$80k/$95k/$115k, which fall at the 41st/72nd/83rd/93rd/98th percentile of the national distribution. Shares its breaks and ramp with the white non-Hispanic style, so switching between the two shows the gap directly; the Census publishes this estimate only where the district's Black household count supports one. 0.69% of districts have a coefficient of variation above 0.3; this style does not fade them, so read median_hh_income_black_moe in the GeoParquet before drawing a conclusion from any single district.
